top_signals.title: US Stocks Fall After Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Will Remain Shut
top_signals.summary: US stocks turned lower Tuesday after Iran said the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until its conditions were met, pushing oil prices higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft August 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 400 flaws, 3 zero-days
top_signals.summary: Today is Microsoft's August 2026 Patch Tuesday, and with it comes security updates for a massive 400 flaws, including one actively exploited and two publicly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities. [...]
